CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA

5:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 74
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR HOFBAUER, DIRECTORS DISPENZA, THOMPSON, AND MARTINEZ
3. CLOSED SESSION – PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
4. PRESENTATION BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the following items to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of obtaining authorization and direction from the Successor Agency to its designated negotiator regarding the two (2) possible sale transactions of the properties listed below.
Property Owner: Successor Agency
Agency Negotiator: James Purtee, Executive Director
Possible Purchaser: Land Developers Associates Corp. (both transactions)
Property One - 12.16 Acres, APN Nos. 3003-002-931 and 3003-002-932
Property Two - 9.44 Acres, APN Nos. 3003-081-922, 923, 924, 925, 926 & 927.
This Closed Session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Section 54956.8. Closed session is recommended because the Successor Agency will be instructing its negotiator regarding terms and conditions of sale, including price and the form, manner and timing of payment, for the possible sale of the real properties identified above.
5. CLOSED SESSION.
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the items discussed in Closed Session.
7. NON-AGENDA ITEMS - PUBLIC COMMENTS:
8. ADJOURNMENT:

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
Mayor Ledford called the meeting to order at 5:00 p.m.
2.
ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR HOFBAUER, DIRECTORS DISPENZA, THOMPSON, AND MARTINEZ
PRESENT:
Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Hofbauer, Director Dispenza, Director Thompson, Director Martinez.
ABSENT:
None.
3.
CLOSED SESSION – PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
None.
4.
PRESENTATION BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the following items to be discussed in Closed Session:
General Counsel Ditzhazy stated this item would be heard as listed.
4.1
The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of obtaining authorization and direction from the Successor Agency to its designated negotiator regarding the two (2) possible sale transactions of the properties listed below.
Property Owner: Successor Agency
Agency Negotiator: James Purtee, Executive Director
Possible Purchaser: Land Developers Associates Corp. (both transactions)
Property One - 12.16 Acres, APN Nos. 3003-002-931 and 3003-002-932
Property Two - 9.44 Acres, APN Nos. 3003-081-922, 923, 924, 925, 926 & 927.
This Closed Session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Section 54956.8. Closed session is recommended because the Successor Agency will be instructing its negotiator regarding terms and conditions of sale, including price and the form, manner and timing of payment, for the possible sale of the real properties identified above.
5.
CLOSED SESSION.
Closed session was held from 5:05 p.m. - 6:10 p.m.
6.
ANNOUNCEMENT BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the items discussed in Closed Session.
General Counsel Ditzhazy stated the Chair and all Directors were present.
Item 4.1 SA – Property One: consisting of the possible sale of 12.16 acres of Agency property to Land Developers Associates Corp. APN Nos. 3003-002-931 and 932 / Property Negotiations
Property Two: consisting of the possible sale of 9.44 acres of Agency property to Land Developers Associates Corp. APN Nos. 3003-081-922 through 927 / Property Negotiations
In closed session the Successor Agency reviewed the terms of the offers to purchase both Property One and Two and provided unanimous direction to its negotiator, Jim Purtee, Executive Director. No further reportable action at this time.
7.
NON-AGENDA ITEMS - PUBLIC COMMENTS:
None.
8.
ADJOURNMENT:
Chair Ledford adjourned the meeting at 6:10 p.m. to June 1, 2016 at 7:00 in the City Hall Council Chamber located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite B, Palmdale, California.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 6th day of July 2016.
